name: pull_kg_per_person
why: Sourced range, PI approval 10 Nov: 21 (sourced pull floor, ALT pull21) to 126.7 = 38 kgf / mu 0.3 (Richards & Whitby 1997: 242, ALT pull38kgf); 300-500 kg (greased rails / rollers) excluded.

name: drag_speed_ms
why: 0.03 m/s floor dropped as unsourced (PI 5 Nov); current sourced range 0.19 (de Haan 2009: 7, 55.5 W at 294 N) to 1.0 (Harris 2016 AAM p. 4 peak), log-uniform as Sobol run 1 params.csv. 0.6 = press figure.

name: other_mandays_per_tower
why: Range kept (headline 2,500 = Webster 1991 Table 1 3,600 - 1,100 inside). Since v11 the pool is Webster's quarry/dress/build man-days at their source day lengths (5/8/8 h) + (value - 2,500) x hours_per_day, so the factor shifts the pool by (value - 2,500) man-days of hours_per_day hours (v8: value x hours_per_day).

name: block_median_kg
why: Range kept (= TOST ends; headline 450 Webster 1991: 852; Lilliu 549 inside).

name: builders_mult
why: Range kept. Applied as m x (base 50, per_extra_tower 25, min 50, max 200): B = clip(round(m (50 + 25 (tw - 1)) x U(0.9, 1.1)), 50 m, 200 m). Log-uniform (symmetric multiplier; the v11 Sobol crew_mult 0.5-2 log-uniform cites the 28 Oct run's builders_mult); the 28 Oct distribution is not on this machine.

name: tonnes_per_tower
why: Sourced range, PI approval 10 Nov: upper end raised to ALT 2,481 (model geometry 1,040 m3 x 2,386 kg/m3, DERIVED) so ALT 1,909 / 2,009 / 2,481 are inside; lower 900 as 28 Oct; headline 1,350.

name: block_sigma
why: 28 Oct run (29 Oct note): 0.3-0.9 uniform (= TOST ends). Kept; DERIVED 0.41-0.72 (PARAM_AUDIT B3) inside.

name: load_unload_h
why: 28 Oct run (29 Oct note): 0.1-1.0 log. Kept; sourced 0.25 / 0.33 / 0.5 h per block inside. Engine B still charges it per land trip (add4 L3 1.2 ph/t acts only in the season engine).

name: hours_per_day
why: 28 Oct run (29 Oct note): 6-10 uniform (= TOST ends). Kept; sourced 5-10 h (Boswinkel 2021: 145-146). Since v11 Webster's man-days use their source day (5/8/8 h), so this is the simulated working day.

name: min_haul_flatm
why: Sourced range, PI approval 10 Nov: the PI's stated 10-20 m (5 Nov), as Sobol run 2; the old 50-300 excluded the headline 15. 69% of sites sit on their outcrop (haul 0 -> this value).

name: household_size
why: 28 Oct run (29 Oct note): 2.5-8.5 uniform, rounded -> 3..8 with equal probability; here as equal-probability integer bins (same distribution). Headline 5 (Webster 1991: 852-854); TOST ends 3 / 8.
